name: Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited
about: Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited manufactures and sells paper machine clothing in India and internationally. The company offers a range of forming fabrics; woven and spiral dryer screens; polyester, polyamide, and kynar pulp fabrics; stuffed spiral screen and herring bone weave press belts; woven and spiral conveyor belts; and stainless-steel mesh products, such as diagonal seams, mould and dandy covers, open ended products, cable meshes, seams, and edges. It also provides diagonal seam and open-ended phosphor bronze mesh wires; and accessories, such as nozzles, doctoring systems and holders, dewatering systems, coater blades, water and fiber recovery products, tail cutters, oscillators, showers, doctor blades, and filters, as well as tensiometers. In addition, the company offers paper making chemicals, including retention and drainage aids, defoamer, deposit control, deinking, binders, surface size, lubricant, insolubilizer, cleaning, tissue processing, activated bentonite, paper coating, OBA, water treatment, dispersant, and lint control products; and generates wind power. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India. Wires and Fabriks (S.A.) Limited is a subsidiary of W & F Securities Pvt Ltd.
